data.name: SteakOut
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the Frontier

Step into a living, breathing Wild West town where the air is thick with the smell of woodsmoke and competition. You aren’t just a visitor; you’re here to claim your stake. Navigate a reactive world where NPCs watch your every move, weather shifts your strategy, and the local law keeps a watchful eye on the growing tension between two rival crews.

    

Build Your Culinary Empire

You and your partner aren't just cooks you’re entrepreneurs in a lawless land.

  • The Daily Grind: Manage a high-speed frontier restaurant, cooking and serving demanding locals to build your reputation.

  • Outshine the Rivalry: It’s a 2v2 race to the top. Earn more, cook faster, and draw the biggest crowds to prove your kitchen reigns supreme.

  • Look the Part: Fully customize your duo with authentic Western outfits and accessories. In this town, your style is your signature.

The Midnight Sabotage

When the sun goes down, the aprons come off and the masks go on. The nighttime belongs to the bold and the desperate.

  • Heists & Sabotage: Sneak into the rival kitchen to steal secret ingredients, raid their storage, or disable their equipment.

  • High-Stakes Stealth: The Sheriff’s deputies patrol the shadows. If you get caught, you’ll lose more than just your pride your money, time, and reputation are all on the line.

  • Tactical Warfare: Defend your own larder or lead a raid using an arsenal of revolvers, shotguns, and repeaters. Whether it’s a long-range standoff or a kitchen-floor shootout, every bullet counts.

Key Features

  • 4-Player Competitive Co-op: A unique 2v2 experience blending fast-paced cooking with tactical combat.

  • Day/Night Cycle: Strategic gameplay shifts from management and efficiency by day to stealth and sabotage by night.

  • Dynamic World: Weather, lighting, and reactive NPCs create an evolving atmosphere that affects visibility and customer flow.

  • Authentic Arsenal: Use specialized ammo types and period-accurate firearms to protect your business or destroy theirs.

  • No Pay-to-Win: All character customizations are purely visual, keeping the playing field as level as a desert floor.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Designed for 1080p at Low–Medium settings.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Achieves around 60–70 FPS at 1080p Epic settings with DLSS enabled.
